buses.name: Plant attach
buses.target: DIII-D now, SPARC/ITER-class later, ICF pulse-shape as sibling

buses.metric: Disruption rate, tearing-onset warning time, stored-energy flattop vs lab baseline

buses.interface: Offline and near-online optimization, not in-loop braiding of a tokamak
buses.metric: Solution quality vs classical HPC at fixed wall-clock

buses.interface: Reactivity ratio R_drive / R_thermal at stated I, ω, n, T, all aux power counted
buses.metric: Never writes a plant Q until Bus A’s ledger accepts auxiliary terms

history.title: Five-head engine (white paper)
history.summary: Majorana braids + fracton memory + Floquet clock + holographic encoder + plasma actuators as one device. Consciousness benchmark still in the surrounding notes. Q = 1000 treated as an output.

history.title: Cut the monolith; keep three buses
history.summary: Cut E-HOL, E-5, consciousness. Keep E-S3, E-QEC, E-RL. Majorana demoted to WATCH. Time crystal cut as clock. Fracton cut as hardware.

history.title: Q = 1000 demoted to ledger test
history.summary: S-Q demoted to ledger test. S-L2 HOLD at PRC 109 field bound. L1/L4 HOLD. L3 solvers KEEP.

history.title: Daily run: this week’s arXiv under existing KEEP claims
history.summary: INCLUDE Tamiya, Polley, Flores, Seo 2024 (lookback), virtual-circuit emulators, braid-without-transport. Heuristic gauges updated. No C move. Floquet-fracton queued as a new-pillar candidate (spacetime fractons), not auto-promoted.

history.title: Layer-2 bibliography: PRC 109/110 + dynamically assisted fusion
history.summary: INCLUDE the published field and intensity bounds into the ledger. Conservative direction only. S-L2 stays HOLD / C1 as a gain path.
